title: Add make install target
description:
The Makefile has no install target. Users must manually copy build/libwolfp11.so and build/wp11 to system directories. This is not standard and makes packaging (Debian, Yocto, Buildroot) harder.

Add:
  install: all
    install -m 0755  /lib/
    install -m 0755  /bin/
    install -m 0644 wolfp11/*.h /include/wolfp11/

Also add an uninstall target. PREFIX should default to /usr/local. DESTDIR should default to empty for packaging support.
